# popnow-java

> Java SDK (Maven `ai.popnow:popnow-java:0.2.0`, package `ai.popnow`, Java 17+, one dependency: Jackson databind 2.12+) for the PopNow API, which generates AI videos, images, music and speech with models such as Kling, Seedance, Wan, Vidu, MiniMax, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Flux and Suno. Billed in exact USD from a prepaid API balance that is separate from website credits; same per-model prices as popnow.ai.

Install: Maven Central `ai.popnow:popnow-java:0.2.0`. Auth: `PopNowClient.builder().apiKey(...)` or `.apiKeyFromEnvironment()` reading `POPNOW_API_KEY` (`sk-popnow-...`, created at https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys; add funds at https://popnow.ai/api/console/billing). Base URL `https://api.popnow.ai/api/v1`. Every JSON response is `{code, msg, data, request_id}`; `code` 200 is success. Requests carry `User-Agent: popnow-java/0.2.0 (+https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-java)`. Money is USD decimal strings (up to nine decimal places) mapped to `BigDecimal`; the integer credit fields are deprecated.

## Core usage

- `client.run(CreateTaskRequest.of("alibaba/z-image-turbo/text-to-image", Map.of("prompt", "...")), idempotencyKey)` -> createTask + waitForTerminal; `task.assets().get(0).url()` is a signed link valid ~20 minutes; `task.costUsd()` is the USD charge (final once `settled()`).
- `client.createTask(request, idempotencyKey)` -> POST /jobs/createTask (retried automatically only with an Idempotency-Key). `CreateTaskOptions.none().withWait(Duration.ofSeconds(30))` holds the request up to 60 s and fills `AcceptedTask.completed()`; `.withRetention(Duration)` sends X-PopNow-Retention.
- `client.waitForTerminal(taskId)` polls GET /jobs/recordInfo with back-off; `PopNowWaitTimeoutException` is a local timeout, not a failure, and carries the task id.
- `client.quote(request)` -> POST /jobs/quote; `quote.maxChargeUsd()` is the hold, `quote.expectedChargeUsd()` the typical charge; `request.withQuote(quote)` sends `quoteId` and `expectedCostUsd` = `maxChargeUsd` (40901 if the price moved). `AcceptedTask.estimatedCostUsd()` is the USD held.
- `client.getTask`, `retryTask`, `purgeTask`, `listTasks(TaskFilter)` for GET /jobs.
- `client.listModels(ModelFilter)`, `getModel(id)` (USD price in `ApiModel.usd()`, JSON Schema in `inputSchema()`).
- Files: `client.uploadFile(Path)` -> `popnow://f/fil_...` (three steps: /common/upload-url, PUT, /files/{id}/commit); `.safetensors` uploads as application/octet-stream; `importLora(url, token)` -> POST /files/import; `createDownloadUrl`.
- Asset library: `client.assets().create(CreateAssetRequest.fromTaskOutput(taskId, 0))` (Idempotency-Key generated) -> `popnow://a/ast_...`; `list`, `listAll`, `get`, `update`, `delete`, `usage`, `uploadFile`, `characters().list/get`.
- Account: `getBalance()` (GET /chat/credit, the API balance: `availableUsd()`, `heldUsd()`, `totalUsd()`), `getUsage(from, to)` (GET /usage, `totalSpend()` in USD).
- Webhooks: `new CallbackSignatureVerifier(secret).verify(rawBody, headerLookup)` for callBackUrl deliveries (base64 HMAC-SHA256 over `taskId.timestamp.sha256hex(body)`); `new EndpointWebhookVerifier(whsecSecret).verify(rawBody, headerLookup)` for Standard Webhooks account endpoints.

## Errors

Sealed `PopNowException`: `PopNowApiException` (`httpStatus()`, `businessCode()`, `reason()`, `requestId()`, `retryAfter()`, `remediation()`), `PopNowProtocolException`, `PopNowTransportException`, `PopNowTimeoutException`, `PopNowWaitTimeoutException`, `PopNowUploadException`, `PopNowWebhookException`. Branch on `businessCode()`: 400, 40003, 40004, 401, 40201 (the API balance cannot cover the hold; add funds), 40202, 403, 40301, 40302, 40303, 40310, 404, 409, 40901, 413, 429, 500, 503, 50301 (retried automatically: 429/5xx/50301), 50302 (refunded; resend with a new idempotency key). Failed generations are tasks with state FAILED and an `errorCode`.
